subject: general
question: National air sports policy 2022 lays out the vision of making India one of the top nations by the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2030**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Air Sports Policy (NASP) 2022 aims to make India one of the top nations in air sports by the year 2030.
 
• The policy focuses on promoting various air sports such as drones, paragliding, skydiving, hang gliding, and aerobatics.
 
• The National Air Sports Policy (NASP) 2022 was launched by the Ministry of Civil Aviation in India.
 
• The National Air Sports Policy (NASP) 2022 was launched by Jyotiraditya Scindia, who was the Minister of Civil Aviation at the time.
